From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aureliatech.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@aureliatech.com
Date: Sun, 19 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning: EWA staging + procurement evidence request

Hi Markus,

Hope you had a good weekend. Our renewal window for Aurelia Tech is coming up (term end 2028-10-31) and procurement asked that we lock an Early Work Agreement (EWA) for a staged capacity increase while we finalize the PO. They need a short checklist of evidence to approve the portal upload and an estimated cadence for PO issuance.

High level asks from procurement:
- SOC 2 evidence or attestation
- Data retention & deletion policy summary
- Example PO language (term change: 12->24 months, committed GPUs/capacity ramp)
- A mutual action plan so procurement can see milestones

Can you confirm whether Redwood can upload the evidence to their procurement portal directly, or if Aurelia procurement needs DocuSign first? We want to avoid a procurement back-and-forth and keep the EWA staging aligned with your ops capacity.

Proposed 30-min walkthrough this week to go over portal upload and approval gates — are you available Wed/Thu?

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Cloud Ops, Aurelia Tech
samir.patel@aureliatech.com
procurement@aureliatech.com

Attachment: procurement_requirements_aur_0828.pdf (pdf stub)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aureliatech.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 19 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: EWA staging + procurement evidence request

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear list. We can support the EWA staging and upload a packet to Aurelia's procurement portal; in practice our usual flow is: evidence upload -> procurement review -> DocuSign of the EWA + PO. That said, if procurement prefers a DocuSign envelope first we can do that before portal upload.

For the portal packet we'll include:
- SOC 2 Type II report (Q1 2028)
- Short data retention & C2C deletion summary (one-page)
- Proposed PO language (we'll include a redline for the 12->24 term change and the capacity ramp schedule)
- Mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and owners

Can you confirm the PO billing contact and whether Aurelia requires invoice-by-month vs invoice-on-commit? Also, which procurement portal record should we attach to? If you paste the portal upload URL we will push the files and send you the packet link.

I’m available Wed Aug 22 10:00–11:30 PT or Thu Aug 23 after 13:00 PT for a 30-min walkthrough. Laura and Hannah are copied to help with evidence.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Partner Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Laura / Hannah —

Quick checklist for the packet we need to upload to Aurelia's procurement portal today if possible:
1) SOC2_report_Q1_2028.pdf (redwood security has the signed report; please pull the most recent cover page + assertion)
2) data_retention_policy.docx — one-page summary (bullet points only)
3) EWA_MAP_Aurelia_2028.xlsx — mutual action plan, milestones, owners, dates
4) PO_language_redline.txt — include the 12->24 month term amendment and a capacity ramp table (months 1-6: +20% reserved capacity; months 7-12: +40%)

Hannah: can you confirm whether we should quote "invoice-on-commit" or "monthly-invoicing" here? Aurelia historically preferred invoice-on-commit but Samir asked about monthly.
Laura: please extract the SOC2 cover page and evidence stub (PDF). Keep the redactions light — we only need the auditor attestation, not internal control narratives.

Target: upload by EOD Tue 20 Aug so Samir can circulate to procurement and we can get the DocuSign envelope ready Wed. I’ll coordinate the MAP and PO redline and attach the DocuSign template.

Thanks — Markus

Markus / team —

Attached is the draft mutual action plan (EWA_MAP_Aurelia_2028.xlsx) and a short PO language snippet below that we can drop into the portal:

--- PO language (snippet) ---
1. Term: The Agreement Term will be amended from twelve (12) months to twenty-four (24) months, effective on the execution date.
2. Capacity Ramp: Customer will increase reserved capacity per schedule: Months 1–6: +20% committed capacity; Months 7–12: +40% committed capacity. Pricing for staged capacity will follow Appendix A (unit pricing table).
3. Invoicing: Invoice-on-commit unless Customer elects monthly invoicing at time of PO submission.
--- end snippet ---

I uploaded the MAP to our shared drive and attached the working MAP to this thread. Laura — SOC2 cover page was added to the shared folder (SOC2_report_Q1_2028.pdf). Hannah — recommend we keep invoice-on-commit as default and give Aurelia the option to request monthly invoicing (we can add that checkbox in the PO redline).

Attachment: EWA_MAP_Aurelia_2028.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Happy to hop on a quick call to finalize before portal upload.

—Ben
